استشففن (form X)

# اُسْتُشْفِفْنَ (ustušfifna) /us.tuʃ.fif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشَفَّ (istašaffa)
# اِسْتَشْفِفْنَ (istašfifna) /is.taʃ.fif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشَفَّ (istašaffa)
